questions.stem: Class A has a mean test score of $65$ and range $30$. Class B has a mean of $62$ and range $10$. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Class A did better on average and their scores were more consistent
Class A did better on average but their scores were more spread out
Class B did better on average and their scores were more consistent
Class B did better on average but their scores were more spread out

questions.explanation: Class A has the higher mean ($65 > 62$), so they did better on average. However, Class A has a larger range ($30 > 10$), meaning their scores were more spread out (less consistent) than Class B.

questions.stem: When comparing two data sets, you should comment on:

options.text: Both a measure of average and a measure of spread
The number of data values only

questions.explanation: A full comparison requires both a measure of central tendency (mean, median, or mode) and a measure of spread (range or interquartile range) to describe both the typical value and how varied the data is.
